text:
jordan: Heads up — kicking off preflight for tonight's 00:30 UTC cutover. Plan is: API v2.7.1, runtime 3.4.0-quant (no new kv semantics unless we gate), console 1.9.2, router 4.0.0-canary. Change window 00:30-02:30 UTC. Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> full. Rollback: immediate unpin to previous stable versions and traffic shift to router-stable. Deploybot will run the canaries and emit signals. @maria (runtime), @chris (router), @ana (console) — pls ack and call out any blockers or required config overrides.

chris: ack. Router side ready but note: header-split migration is still folded into this build. If console can't handle new headers we should disable header-split flag in the router for the canary. Also router canary mem footprint looks +10% vs stable on staging.

maria: runtime ack. One thing: this runtime build enables a minor kv-eviction tuning change (eviction_threshold -> 0.65). I want to hold eviction at 0.7 for the canary to avoid regressing cold-start hit rates. If we can pin runtime variant that keeps eviction_threshold: 0.7, i'm 👍.

ana: holding on console. Org-level toggle for accepting the extra headers is not yet released to prod; I can ship a tiny guard today but it's on a 02:00 UTC deploy path. Prefer we run router with header-split disabled until console toggle is live.

deploybot: queued wave #rw-17485. Canary config attached: {
  "canary_pct": 5,
  "canary_duration_min": 15,
  "fail_conditions": ["error_rate>0.5%","p99_lat>800ms","increase_request_timeout"]
}

jordan: good catches. New plan: proceed with API + runtime canary (runtime pinned with eviction_threshold:0.7 per @maria), router will deploy but with ROUTER_HEADER_SPLIT=false for canary. console patch will land at 02:00 UTC and @ana will flip the flag then. Canary pct 5% as deploybot shows. SRE: monitor p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, and token generation latency. If p99 > 750ms or 5xx > 0.25% abort and rollback. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: alert thresholds set. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/ops/release-watch?var=wave=rw-17485
- p50 baseline 120ms
- p95 baseline 330ms
- p99 baseline 720ms
- error_rate baseline 0.08%
We'll post a green/red after the first 5m window.

chris: OK will push router with env override. Command I will run for canary job:

```
kubectl set env deployment/router-canary ROUTER_HEADER_SPLIT=false --namespace=prod-canary
```

maria: i'll publish a runtime variant tag that locks eviction to 0.7: runtime:3.4.0-quant-ev0.7. Please make sure deploybot targets that tag for the runtime pool.

ana: noted. i'll post when the console toggle is on (02:03 UTC expected). Until then flag remains off. Will also hold UI rollout until router header health is reported post-canary.

deploybot: canary start triggered by @jordan at 00:31 UTC. Rolling to 5% now. Jobs: api-v2.7.1 -> ok, runtime:3.4.0-quant-ev0.7 -> ok, router:4.0.0-canary (HDR_SPLIT=false) -> rolling.

deploybot: canary progress: 5% reached at 00:36 UTC. Health checks passing: 200/200 short requests, no obvious errors. Watching metrics...

maria: watching runtime metrics — flagging p99 token latency creeping to 980ms on a subset of nodes, spiky. snippet from runtime logs:
```
[00:37:12] WARN kv_fetch_miss latency=980ms worker=runtime-3-7
[00:37:13] WARN kv_eviction_scan took=120ms
```
This is above our abort threshold. Recommend pause and consider rollback of runtime to 3.3.9 while we investigate.

jordan: hm — we set abort at p99>750ms. @maria can you trigger rollback if you're seeing that across the canary? @chris do we see router-related correlation? @sre-bot any sudden infra anomalies?

chris: router metrics look fine, no clear correlation from router side. CPU steady.

sre-bot: infra checks: no node restarts, no cluster autoscaler actions, network latencies OK.

maria: rolling back runtime now — initiating rollback to runtime:3.3.9. Command:
```
deploybot rollback component=runtime target=3.3.9 wave=rw-17485 initiated_by=maria
```

deploybot: rollback acknowledged. Rolling runtime back to 3.3.9 across canary subset. Pausing further canary ramp. Notifying release channel.

jordan: thanks — pausing router ramp as well and holding API. We'll keep router canary at 5% but pause any increase. Ana pls don't flip console flag until we see runtime stabilized.

ana: understood. console toggle will be held. I'll follow up once i see runtime green and then patch console post-02:00 if safe.

deploybot: rollback complete at 00:45 UTC. Runtime back to 3.3.9, canary health re-evaluating: p99 now 640ms, error_rate stable. Canary status: paused_at_5% (auto-paused by rollback event).

jordan: postmortem action items: 1) mark kv-eviction change as candidate for extended staging tests, 2) improve runtime canary p99 alert sensitivity, 3) add a quick L7 correlation between router header-splits and runtime kv patterns. I'll file a short follow-up doc. For now we'll reschedule change window to next midnight. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination. :raised_hands:

chris: acked. I'll keep the router flag ready to be toggled when console is ready.

maria: filing a runtime rollback blameless note and opening the kv-tuning PR with more perf tests.

ana: will replan console patch to 02:00 next slot. Thanks all.
